items.description:
Netcare Pholoso Hospital is a private hospital in Fauna Park offering specialist and acute healthcare services to patients across Polokwane and the wider Limpopo region. Its emergency and trauma unit, maternity and neonatal care, paediatric ward and surgical teams work alongside a broad range of medical specialities, including cardiology, cardiothoracic surgery, ENT, general surgery, gynaecology, internal medicine, neurology, neurosurgery, oncology, ophthalmology, orthopaedic and spinal surgery, urology and vascular surgery, supported by theatres, a cardiac catheterisation unit, endoscopy and radiology services.

The 200-bed hospital was developed in partnership between Netcare and the Pholoso Hospital Group and opened in 2015. It holds Level II Trauma Centre accreditation from the Trauma Society of South Africa and has a helicopter landing pad for air-ambulance patients, allowing its emergency unit to provide round-the-clock, multidisciplinary care for serious and potentially life-threatening injuries, making it a key point of care for patients needing surgical, medical, maternity, paediatric and specialist treatment in the region.

Bennie Boekwurm Pre-school is a preschool and nursery and day-care facility for young children, catering for ages from birth to around six years old, in the Ladanna area of Polokwane. Alongside its early-years care, the school runs a dedicated homework centre, established in 2024, which provides structured homework assistance and additional academic support for school-going learners from Grade 1 upward, with support reported for Grade 1 to 3 learners and mathematics support extending as far as Grade 7.

The pre-school is based at 21 Mara Street in Ladanna, Polokwane, and has been operating in the local community since at least 2018. It serves young children needing early childhood care alongside school-going learners from the wider Ladanna and Polokwane area who require homework assistance and additional academic support outside school hours.

Kurumba Lodge in Polokwane offers luxury accommodation, fine dining and conference facilities in one place. Its 28 ensuite rooms are well appointed with modern amenities, and its self-catering units sit in a garden that the lodge describes as a private oasis.

The restaurant serves fine food and wine, and Jouba's Pub offers a casual lunch, after-work drinks and live sports. Guests can also book intimate seated dining, and the lodge says it welcomes walk-in visitors as well as advance bookings. Conference and function facilities cater for year-end celebrations, weddings, birthday parties and productive business meetings.

The lodge says safety and comfort come first, with its own reservoir and a backup generator to keep services running. Wi-Fi, laundry and ironing services are included, and the lodge is in the Hospital Park area of Polokwane.

Girasole Energy is a solar energy supplier in Polokwane, Limpopo, established in 2015. Its range covers solar panels, batteries, grid-tie inverters from 5kW to 100kW, hybrid and backup systems, solar kits and solar pumps, along with accessories.

The business says it grew out of an electrical motor rewinding business that has operated for more than 50 years, and it describes itself as an official partner of S and P Power Units, a Gauteng company with more than 22 years of solar experience. Its website says it uses high-end products from European suppliers and lists brands including Canadian Solar, Fronius, Blue Nova, Freedom Won and Hoppecke.

Recent projects listed on the website include an 8kWp grid-tie SMA system and semi off-grid hybrid systems for homes, and the company is based in Superbia, Polokwane.

Marlot Guest House is a Polokwane guesthouse offering luxurious accommodation in the heart of the city. It is aimed at business visitors and travellers exploring Limpopo, and the website describes its rooms as uniquely decorated with tranquil surroundings.

All rooms have DStv Open View, a mini bar fridge, tea and coffee facilities and air conditioning, and they are serviced daily. Breakfast is served each morning, and guests can use the swimming pool. The guesthouse also has a fully equipped function venue that seats 30 people, and its board room can accommodate up to 30 delegates for business meetings or group breakaways.

The guesthouse is close to the main access roads, and its website offers a photo gallery and 360-degree virtual tours before booking.

Forty 4 on Hoog is a boutique guesthouse in Polokwane with four spacious, luxurious suites, run by its owners, who have more than 30 years of experience in hospitality. The website describes the stay as soft luxury, with a welcome based on warm friendship and true hospitality.

The suites range from a 24 square metre junior suite, aimed at business travellers and fitted with a king bed and walk-in shower, to a 48 square metre junior deluxe suite and a 75 square metre king deluxe suite. The king deluxe suite has a lounge, a flat-screen television with a full DStv package, a bio-ethanol fireplace and a fresh fruit platter. Super king and presidential suites are also offered, and the suites described above are air-conditioned.

Guests can use the swimming pool and the garden, and the business is located on Hoog Street in the Capricorn area of Polokwane.
